test_title: PYST 48: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

The tea at this café is best than at the Costa Café in our office.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the comparative adjective "**best**" instead of the correct comparative form "**better**".
 
• **Comparative adjectives** are used to** compare** differences between the two objects they modify.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**is better than**", ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **option 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The tea at this café is **better than** at the Costa Café in our office."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "at the Costa Café"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "The tea at this café"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "in our office"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
